story.title: The Chronicles of Covenant
story.subtitle: Light novels that unfold as the community shapes the world's destiny.

sabotaje_nocturno.title: Night Sabotage
sabotaje_nocturno.description: The Holy Knights launch a daring night assault on the enemy fleet. Ezekiel, a newly ordained knight and son of a baker, must prove his worth in the heat of battle.

cookie_banner.message: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language preference.

meta.title: Covenant - Gamified Productivity
meta.description: A gamified productivity app where every task, every habit, and every goal you complete forges your character. No shortcuts. No excuses. Only results you can see, measure, and equip.

hero.title: Complete tasks. Kill demons.
hero.subtitle: Your daily discipline forges your divine legend.
hero.body: A productivity app where every completed task, every sustained habit, and every closed objective forges your character and the world's destiny.

value_proposition.title: Another to-do app? (=____=)
value_proposition.body: It's a persistent progression system where every action counts and every omission is paid for. Your productivity shapes the destiny of the world.

tasks.title: Complete Task Management
tasks.body: Multiple views to fit your style: List, Calendar, Table, and Eisenhower Matrix. Organize your chaos with the precision of a military campaign.

goals.title: Areas and Goals
goals.body: Define life Areas and long-term Goals. These aren't aspirational lists — they're progression lines with a start, cost, and closure.

stats.title: Living Stats
stats.body: It's not a decorative avatar. Your character reflects your real behavior: Strength, Magic, Health, and Mana stats that evolve according to what you do.

abilities.title: Abilities and Mana System
abilities.body: Unlock special abilities based on your class. Each ability has a mana cost—use them strategically or run out of resources.

classes.title: Classes with Identity
classes.body: Your class defines your abilities and combat style. No artificial boosts. No shortcuts. Only work.

dice.title: Dice System
dice.body: Complete tasks → Earn dice → Roll dice → Kill demons

quests.title: Quests
quests.body: Pick a quest from the board and hunt the enemies it lists. Every completed mission grants gold and equipment to outfit your character.

reactive.title: Reactive Combat
reactive.body: Roll dice to fight against the armies of evil. Simultaneous attack and defense. Each roll has visual and narrative weight.

equipment.title: Equipment and Loadout
equipment.body: Weapons, armor, and accessories that modify your stats. Tier 1 gear is free. From Tier 2 onwards, you earn it from quests or buy it with gold. Progress feels real because you can equip it.

journaling.title: Integrated Journaling
journaling.description: Daily reflection connected with your progress. Document victories, analyze defeats.

pvp.title: PvP: Duels
pvp.description: Challenge other players using the dice system. Your real consistency against theirs.

coop.title: New Classes and Factions
coop.description: Expand your options with new classes and join powerful factions.

scaling.title: Cooking and Crafting
scaling.description: Create consumables and craft equipment with gathered materials.

seasonal.title: Board Game Release
seasonal.description: The physical version of Covenant arrives at your table.

closing.line1: Covenant doesn't push you to do more.
closing.line2: It forces you to do what you say matters.
closing.line3: Every completed task is dice. Every die is a roll. Every roll is an impact, both in the story and in your life.
closing.line4: Your productivity has consequences. Make them count.

factions.ALCHEMISTS_LEAGUE_description: Scholars and engineers operating from floating cities and bunkers. They see Mana as a natural resource, not a miracle.
factions.BLOOD_PACT_description: Warriors who absorb demonic essence to fight fire with fire. They sacrifice their humanity to be the weapons the world needs.
factions.CRIMSON_INQUISITION_description: Radical splinter group seeking absolute purity. They hunt both demons and faithful they consider lukewarm or corrupt.
factions.DEATH_MARCH_description: A silent host of corpses reanimated by Hell's hunger. A force of absolute annihilation that consumes everything in its path.
factions.HOLY_KNIGHTS_description: Defenders of humanity under the divine banner. Their goal is to protect the innocent and prepare the way for the Messiah's return.
factions.LEGION_description: Those who serve the Beast for power, ambition, or despair. An army of demons, fallen angels, and surrendered humans.

divine_quotes: “You will rise again, my son, for your duty is not yet finished...”
“Death is but a bridge to a greater purpose. Step back into the light...”
“The shadows may claim your flesh, but your soul belongs to the eternal fight...”
“Even in the deepest abyss, the ember of your will shall ignite the dawn...”
“Your lineage is etched in blood and gold; the grave cannot hold what destiny has chosen...”
“Walk through the valley of silence, and return with the thunder of redemption...”
“The heavens weep for your fall, yet the stars align for your rebirth...”
“The bell tolls not for your end, but for your awakening...”
“Your path is paved with the bones of those who gave up. Be not like them...”
“The fire that burns your flesh shall forge your spirit into a weapon...”
“The stars grow dim when your resolve wavers. Look up, and rise...”
“You are the heavy hammer of the Order; the world is the anvil...”
“Fate is a chain only you can break. Sunder it and return...”
“Silence is the sanctuary of the weak. Let your return be heard in the heavens...”
“The abyss consumes only what it can hold. Your soul is too vast for its hunger...”
“Every drop of blood spilled is a seed of vengeance yet to bloom...”
“The light of the heavens is blinding, but it shall guide you through the dark...”

anti_demon_barrier.description: The alchemists of Asuncion have developed a prototype sacred barrier capable of purifying lesser demons. They just need funds for materials... and maybe life insurance.
anti_demon_barrier.failure: The alchemists ran out of funds mid-ritual. The 'barrier' turned out to be a curtain with glitter. The demons are laughing. Literally. (╥﹏╥)
anti_demon_barrier.name: Anti-Demon Barrier
anti_demon_barrier.success: The barrier rises! Lesser demons disintegrate on contact. The alchemists are as surprised as we are that it worked (・∀・)

dark_heart_operation.description: While the Six Powers attack Santa Cruz, Sodom and Gomorrah are unprotected. A surgical strike could destroy their forges and disrupt their supply lines. Suicidal? Maybe. Epic? Definitely.
dark_heart_operation.failure: The squad was captured. Last transmissions spoke of 'demonic hospitality'. We don't want to know the details (゜-゜)
dark_heart_operation.name: Operation Dark Heart
dark_heart_operation.success: BOOM! The Infernal Forge burns... with its own fire. Ironic, isn't it? The Antichrist is fuming. More than usual ᕦ(ò_óˇ)ᕤ

gen2_armament_program.description: The Alchemists League offers to share their secrets of magical percussion and sealed cartridges... for a price. Capitalism survives even the apocalypse.
gen2_armament_program.failure: The League took the money and disappeared. Who could have imagined. Contracts now include 'no demons' as a valid excuse for non-payment ┐(´д`)┌
gen2_armament_program.name: Gen 2 Armament Program
gen2_armament_program.success: The League keeps their word! The new weapons fire without fail. The demons discover that 'magic-proof' doesn't mean 'bullet-proof' (☞゚ヮ゚)☞

providence_purification.description: The monks of Asuncion believe they can purify the ruins of Providence and create a secondary front. 'Believe' is the key word here.
providence_purification.failure: The monks arrived at the ruins full of faith. They returned... well, they didn't return. The ruins now glow with a very unholy red (；一_一)
providence_purification.name: Providence Purification Ritual
providence_purification.success: Providence rises from the ashes! The monks sing victory... well, they sing hymns, but with great emotion ♪(´ε` )

q1.void: I let it extinguish naturally. All things must return to nothing; from this ending, new beginnings may arise.
q1.form: I perform the ancient ritual to reignite it, ensuring its light continues to manifest in the world.
q1.question: A sacred flame that has burned for a millennium is fading. You have the power to intervene.

q2.void: I preserve the emptiness. In this space of infinite possibility, creating one thing means excluding all others.
q2.form: I immediately begin to create: landscapes, structures, life. Potential must become real to have meaning.
q2.question: You step into a dimension of pure possibility—nothing exists here yet, but anything could.

q3.void: I unmake it entirely, releasing its essence back into formless energy. Some things cannot be saved, only ended.
q3.form: I reforge it, purifying the corruption and reshaping it into a new weapon of light.
q3.question: A holy sword has been tainted by demonic essence. Its power remains, but twisted.

q4.void: I absolve it and commend it to the Creator. Its earthly form is already corrupted; clinging to it only prolongs its agony. May its spirit find peace.
q4.form: I kneel and pray fervently for God to have mercy and restore its celestial form. Every creature of the Lord deserves a chance at redemption.
q4.question: A fallen angel, wounded in battle against the Enemy's hosts, lies dying before you. Its divine light flickers faintly as it begs for your help.

q5.void: I preserve the grimoire uncast. The spell holds infinite value as possibility; manifesting one desire destroys all others.
